title: Fast and Memory-Efficient Wavelet Convolutions via I/O-Aware Reformulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.10805v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Wavelet convolution (WTConv) has emerged as an increasingly popular drop-in replacement for standard convolutions, expanding a network's receptive field exponentially with the number of decomposition levels while keeping the parameter count linear. However, its reference implementation is severely memory-bound due to excessive data movement through high-bandwidth memory (HBM). translated_title: 通过I/O感知重构实现快速且内存高效的小波卷积
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10805v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：小波卷积（WTConv）已成为标准卷积日益流行的替代方案，通过分解级别的数量指数级扩展网络的感受野，同时保持参数数量线性增长。然而，其参考实现由于通过高带宽内存（HBM）的过度数据移动而严重受内存限制。我们开发了一个WTConv的I/O模型来表征这一瓶颈，并用它指导三种代数重构：（1）在芯片上重新计算廉价的Haar分析蝶形运算，（2）将多级合成级联折叠为单个由输出坐标位索引的闭式传递，（3）将学习到的逐通道缩放因子折叠到卷积权重中。这些重构共同实现了一个I/O感知的融合实现，大幅减少了HBM流量。我们评估了不同分解级别下的WTConvNeXt配置，以及更广泛的设置。
tldr: 本文通过I/O感知的代数重构（包括片上重计算、级联折叠和权重缩放融合），显著减少了小波卷积中的高带宽内存流量，实现了快速且内存高效的WTConv实现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces I/O-aware algebraic reformulations (including on-chip recomputation, cascade collapsing, and weight scale folding) to significantly reduce high-bandwidth memory traffic in wavelet convolutions, enabling fast and memory-efficient WTConv implementations.
